label: Pi Remote should preserve OGAM's service-owned stream, replace-all preview projection, durable-message replacement, and tombstone-before-discard ordering.
Near-bottom-gated autoscroll, delayed initial reveal, stable scroll anchoring, and jump-to-bottom affordance are directly adoptable in the browser.
Browser popovers should measure after visual-viewport keyboard geometry settles, with safe-area padding and cancellable listeners.
Composer send/stop/voice precedence and pending attachment ownership translate cleanly; attachment durability remains open.
Immutable historical rows, memoized rendering, stable tool-call keys, external accordion state, and chunk-safe reasoning parsing are adoptable transcript rules.
The exact shared sync lease, renewal, sequence window, expiry, and late-frame semantics remain UNKNOWN because the sibling package is absent.

text: remoteChatStreamStore is a non-durable replace-all preview projection; focused tests remove the preview when the durable reply arrives.
supersedeSyncedReplies emits durable deletion for preview message IDs before discarding the preview.
ChatMessageArea hides initial layout until scroll-to-end settles, follows only while near bottom, and exposes jump-to-bottom behavior.
useKeyboardAwarePopover dismisses the keyboard and delays measurement until the input bar settles; useKeyboardHeight exposes measured keyboard geometry.
MessageRenderer memoizes stable historical items; tool rows use stable toolCall identity and external accordion state; ThinkTagParser buffers split tags.
